notes: Source-backed basket reviewed independently across all 50 cases by two blinded reviewers and adjudicated against official source pages. Equivalent answer pages are grouped so any one may satisfy the same information need. The repository owner reviewed and explicitly approved the fixed answer key on 2026-08-13; no questions, judgments, or thresholds changed during approval.

metric_contract.route_recall_at_3: Micro required-namespace recall over the 45 answer-bearing cases after truncating each automatic route to its first three namespaces.
metric_contract.complete_multi_corpus_coverage: All expected namespaces must appear in the first three automatic routes for every one of the 10 multi-corpus cases.
metric_contract.incorrect_high_confidence_single_routes: Count initially high-confidence singleton routes whose initial singleton is not exactly the case's required namespace set, even when final retrieval widens; the required count is zero.
metric_contract.automatic_recall_at_5: Micro recall over required answer/facet groups made available by exhaustive retrieval across all four enabled eligible corpora. Any judged equivalent URL recalls its group, and each group receives credit at most once per query.
metric_contract.reranking_ndcg_at_5: Macro-average nDCG@5 before and after MiniLM reranking over the 10 multi-corpus cases. Exhaustive-available answer/facet groups form the ideal set, and each group receives gain at most once.
metric_contract.reranking_recall_at_5: Micro Recall@5 before and after reranking over exhaustive-available answer/facet groups in the 10 multi-corpus cases; reranking must not regress it.
metric_contract.average_automatic_fanout: Mean final automatic route count over all 50 cases, including no-answer cases.
